editorial:
Ever felt like your teacher was out to get you? You will totally relate to Jesse, a thirteen-year-old who can't stand his mean teacher, Mrs. Fink. While hanging out at an antique shop, he finds a creepy doll that looks just like her and decides to buy it for some laughs. But things get weird fast. After he pokes the doll with a needle, the real Mrs. Fink shows up to school with her arm in a sling. It turns out the doll is linked to the teacher in a spooky way, and it starts talking and moving on its own. It is a fun mix of a kid's adventure and a creepy ghost story that feels like a classic 90s throwback.

The acting is great and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling too slow. You will love how the pranks go wrong and turn into a real fight for survival. While some of the special effects look a bit dated now, they actually add to the charm of the film. If you want a lighthearted scare, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the end, Jesse realizes the doll is a dangerous tool that allows him to hurt Mrs. Fink, but it eventually tries to take over. After a chaotic showdown, Jesse has to destroy the doll to break the magical link. Once the doll is gone, Mrs. Fink is no longer under its spell or being hurt by the pranks. Jesse learns his lesson about revenge, and the movie wraps up with things returning to normal at school.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s nostalgia and creepy dolls.
